main_measure.name: mean 5-day unusual move in the short direction

statistic.name: t of the mean, same-day cases taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 30 cases and supporting check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 30 cases

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move above minus below the median |forecast|

decided_by: The t lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Active bars whose 5-day return or range ratio cannot be computed inside the record are left out of the agreement share; a case is the first short bet in each 5-bar cell of its window, cases with no full 5-bar return in the window are dropped, the t clusters cases by UTC day, and the supporting check compares cases strictly above with cases strictly below the median |forecast| (ties left out).
